{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Indigo Academy |image=Indigo Academy.png |characters=セキエイ学園 |japanese=Sekiei Academy |imagesize=250px |region=Kanto |colorscheme=Paldea |epicode=HZ001 |episode=The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One) }} '''Indigo Academy''' (Japanese: '''セキエイ学園''' ''Sekiei Academy'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive boarding school in [[Kanto]], located near {{rt|22|Kanto}}. [[Liko]] attends the school in ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. ==In animation== [[File:Liko choosing Sprigatito.png|thumb|200px|Liko welcoming Sprigatito as her Pokémon partner on her first day of class at Indigo Academy]] ===Overview=== To enter Indigo Academy, a potential student must complete several interviews with teachers to define their skills and interests with their potential Pokémon partners. As part of the Indigo Academy initiation process, the Headmistress gives a talk about the [[Pokémon world]], and soon after, the teachers give the students their respective [[Rotom Phone]]s and [[first partner Pokémon]]. The Academy's subjects cover aspects of the Pokémon world, such as {{pkmn|battle}} methods, partnership, and [[friendship]] with the respective Pokémon partner. Despite being mostly face-to-face, Indigo Academy has a distance learning modality. In this case, the class is broadcast live via a Rotom Phone for students to watch. As suggested in ''[[HZ091|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part Two)]]'', Indigo Academy has a student body called the Selection Team, where the students who stand out the most are nominated for a spot in the [[Pokémon League]] competition. To date, the only known student to have received this recognition was [[Ann]]. ===Pins=== Entering Indigo Academy, depending on the academic year they're admitted in, students are given a pin placed on their uniforms, displaying a [[Type]] symbol. These are the class year symbols currently known. In ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'', [[Liko]] was first shown with a {{t|Grass}} symbol. After entering into the bus, three other students can be seen with the {{t|Fire}} symbol, as of current, their year is unknown. In ''[[HZ090|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part One)]]'', after a year later has passed, students who see Liko as their upperclassmen can be seen with a {{t|Water}} symbol. {| class="roundtable c" style="background: #{{indigo color}}; border: 3px solid #{{indigo color dark}}; width: 10%;" ! style="background:#{{indigo color light}}" |Grass ! style="background:#{{indigo color light}}" |Fire ! style="background:#{{indigo color light}}" |Water |- | [[File:Grass icon SwSh.png|50px]] | [[File:Fire icon SwSh.png|50px]] | [[File:Water icon SwSh.png|50px]] |} ===History=== ====Background==== At some point in the past, [[Liko]]'s parents, [[Lucca]] and [[Alex]], studied at the academy. ===={{aniseries|HZ}}==== In ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'', [[Liko]] began her classes at Indigo Academy and, after receiving her first Pokémon and meeting her roommate [[Ann]], she spent a few days adapting to her new Pokémon partner. Later, the Indigo Academy was the site of the first clash between the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and the [[Explorers]]. In ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', Liko revealed to Ann that she would only participate remotely in classes from then on. [[File:Liko Teacher Rotom Phone.png|250px|left|thumb|A day of classes at Indigo Academy]] As Liko started traveling with the Rising Volt Tacklers, the Indigo Academy started to appear in some specific events during the plot of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. In ''[[HZ008|The Door That Never Opens]]'', Liko was briefly shown participating in an online class. In ''[[HZ021|The Lonely Hatenna]]'', Liko was seen finishing participating in a class, after which Liko talked a little with Ann about the task they received which involved what each of the students would like to be in the future. In ''[[HZ035|The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap!]]'', Liko was shown participating in another online class, this time the objective of the class was for each student to choose a {{pkmn|Trainer}} and their Pokémon and write a dissertation about it. The Indigo Academy briefly appeared in a flashback in ''[[HZ040|Farewell, Sprigatito?]]'', where it was revealed that a group of [[Pokémon Breeder]]s joined the teachers during each student's interviews. These Pokémon Breeders are responsible for raising the [[first partner Pokémon]] that will go to each of the students. In this episode, Liko met [[Marnya]], one of these breeders. In ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]'', Liko transferred to [[Naranja Academy]] and it was revealed that Ann did the same. In ''[[HZ067|Shine on, Terastallization! Liko vs. Roy!]]'', after completing the [[Tera Training]], Ann revealed to Liko that she would return to Indigo Academy to improve herself as a Trainer. Biology |- |} ===Locations=== '''Auditorium:''' During the beginning of the school year, students receive a lecture in the auditorium about the [[World of Pokémon]] from the Headmistress. '''Battlefields:''' Battlefields are available for students to use to practice their {{pkmn|battle|battling}}. In ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'', [[Ann]] and [[Liko]] watched as a {{p|Machoke}} battled against an {{p|Espeon}} on one of the battlefields. Later, they had a battle against each other with their {{p|Oshawott}} and {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}, respectively. '''Dorms:''' It is shown that each student at Indigo Academy has a room that they share with another classmate. Liko shared her room with Ann during her stay there. Liko and Ann's room is number 303. '''Clocktower:''' Indigo Academy has a clocktower, where [[Friede]] and [[Amethio]] have their first battle there during Liko's escape from the [[Explorers]].
